name: Vincom Center Dong Khoi
summary: Shopping tower at Lê Thánh Tôn and Đồng Khởi: shop the mall on the walk from the cathedral toward the river. The building is at 72 Lê Thánh Tôn and 45A Lý Tự Trọng, about 750 metres from Bạch Đằng. The welcome page pairs it with Saigon Centre–Takashimaya.
fee: Check on arrival. No door fee was printed.
getThere: On the Đồng Khởi walk, at 72 Lê Thánh Tôn.
kicker: The mall at Lê Thánh Tôn
heroCaption: The glass tower and the VINCOM name, at Lê Thánh Tôn and Đồng Khởi
body: Vincom Center is the shopping tower the welcome page names with Saigon Centre–Takashimaya. The waterbus station page places it at 72 Lê Thánh Tôn and 45A Lý Tự Trọng, Phường Bến Nghé, about 750 metres from Bạch Đằng. The photograph is that corner: the glass tower, the VINCOM letters, and the street signs for Lê Thánh Tôn and Đồng Khởi.

The second photograph is the same tower from across the junction, with the cantilevered roof against the sky. A shop-hour and a door fee were not printed. The visit is the mall on the walk between the cathedral and the river.
